entities.name: Thomas Gardiner Corcoran
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Thomas Gardiner Corcoran was an Irish-American legal scholar. He was one of several advisors in President Franklin D. Roosevelt's brain trust during the New Deal, and later, a close friend and advisor to President Lyndon B. Johnson.
